title: Europe heatwave live: Temperatures of 40C expected in Spain, with amber heat health warning in place across large parts of UK
summary_full: In France, 80 departments have been placed on an orange heat warningEnvironment editorAmidst the “shattering” heat in Europe, a UK government former chief scientific adviser has warned of worse to come and how climate actions protect – not damage – economies.“And yet we are so often told, by parts of the media and in the softer corridors of debate, that net zero costs too much, that we should talk more about jobs and the economy and less about climate. I am here to say the two cannot be separated. Any plan for growth that does not put climate first, or at the very least on an equal footing, can only undermine the future it claims to protect.This has to be the moment for brave leadership. More action, not less. Hold the line, do not row back. If not now, then when?” Continue reading...
